## Air Ambulance Network | Air Ambulance Services

# Premium Air Ambulance Services – 800.880.9451

Air Ambulance Network takes care of your loved ones with seamless bedside-to-bedside transportation.
This includes the use of [Air Medical Transport][37], Commercial Medical Escort (CME), and
International Commercial Stretcher services. Our air ambulances provide everything from basic and
cardiac life support to critical care. We pride ourselves on being one of the top air ambulance
companies in the nation. The [air medical services][38] we offer are world-class with only the
highest-rated pilots, critical care registered nurses, and critical care paramedics or respiratory
therapists. We even have connections to fully-certified physicians and doctors if the situation
calls for it.

#### Our 5 star service
* The most experience in the industry
* 24/7 Availability
* Direct contact with your coordinator who knows you and your situation every step of the way
* Tailored solutions to your specific needs
* We’ll work out the details between you and your insurance provider

#### Quality in Everything
* Only the highest critical care trained physicians and staff ready to attend to your needs
* The most advanced medical equipment available
* Fully licensed and insured
* Extensive quality assurance program from pre-flight and flight coordination to follow up with
  family and case mangers

#### Latest Articles
* [5 Tips for Planning an Air Ambulance Flight][39]
* [What is a Medical Escort?][40]
* [Cost Considerations for Non Emergency Medical Transport Services][41]
* [Safety & Quality in Medical Transport][42]

#### Transport Coordinators
* Quick and efficient
* 24/7 Availability
* Direct contact with your coordinator who knows you and your situation every step of the way
* Unlike other [Air Ambulance companies][43] which may take a day or more to set up medical
  transports, We strive to have transports coordinated as quickly as possible.

#### Patients & Family
* We take care of everything
* Bedside to bedside service
* Tailored solutions for you and your loved one’s specific needs
* Your flight coordinator will communicate all the details to you by whichever means you prefer.

#### Air Ambulance Cost & Options
* At Air Ambulance Network, we try to make it as convenient as possible to pay for the cost of your
  transport.
* Payment methods include credit card, bank transfers, check, money order, most health insurance,
  and Medicaid (in some states.)
* Give our Transport Coordinator a call to request a quote and find out what your [Air Ambulance
  Cost][44] will be. Then learn more about our payment options.

## Our promise to you

### 30-day money back guarantee

HugeDomains provides a 100% satisfaction guarantee on every domain name that we sell through our
website. If you buy a domain and are unhappy with it, we will accept the return within 30 days and
issue a full refund – no questions asked.

### Quick delivery of the domain

In most cases access to the domain will be available within one to two hours of purchase, however
access to domains purchased after business hours will be available within the next business day.

### Safe and secure shopping

Your online safety and security is our top priority. We understand the importance of protecting your
personal information.

We protect your information through SSL encryption technology, providing the safest, most secure
shopping experience possible. Additionally, you may checkout with PayPal or Escrow.com.

## FAQs

[See more FAQs][23]
[How do I transfer to another registrar such as GoDaddy?][24]

Yes, you can transfer your domain to any registrar or hosting company once you have purchased it.
Since domain transfers are a manual process, it can take up to 5 days to transfer the domain.

 

Domains purchased with payment plans are not eligible to transfer until all payments have been made.
Please remember that our 30-day money back guarantee is void once a domain has been transferred.

 

For transfer instructions to GoDaddy, please [click here][25].

[How do I get the domain after the purchase?][26]

Once you purchase the domain we will push it into an account for you at our registrar,
NameBright.com, we will then send you an email with your NameBright username and password. In most
cases access to the domain will be available within one to two hours of purchase, however access to
domains purchased after business hours will be available within the next business day.

[What comes with the domain name?][27]

Nothing else is included with the purchase of the domain name. Our registrar NameBright.com does
offer email packages for a yearly fee, however you will need to find hosting and web design services
on your own.

[Do you offer payment plans?][28]

Yes we offer payment plans for up to 12 months. [See details][29].

[How do I keep my personal information private?][30]

If you wish the domain ownership information to be private, add WhoIs Privacy Protection to your
domain. This hides your personal information from the general public.

 

To add privacy protection to your domain, do so within your registrar account. NameBright offers
WhoIs Privacy Protection for free for the first year, and then for a small fee for subsequent years.

 

Whois information is not updated immediately. It typically takes several hours for Whois data to
update, and different registrars are faster than others. Usually your Whois information will be
fully updated within two days.

issue a full refund – no questions asked.

access to domains purchased after business hours will be available within the next business day.

Your online safety and security is our top priority. We understand the importance of protecting your
personal information.

shopping experience possible. Additionally, you may checkout with PayPal or Escrow.com.

## FAQs

[How do I transfer to another registrar such as GoDaddy?][24]

Yes, you can transfer your domain to any registrar or hosting company once you have purchased it.
Since domain transfers are a manual process, it can take up to 5 days to transfer the domain.

 

Domains purchased with payment plans are not eligible to transfer until all payments have been made.
Please remember that our 30-day money back guarantee is void once a domain has been transferred.

NameBright.com, we will then send you an email with your NameBright username and password. In most
cases access to the domain will be available within one to two hours of purchase, however access to
domains purchased after business hours will be available within the next business day.

Nothing else is included with the purchase of the domain name. Our registrar NameBright.com does
offer email packages for a yearly fee, however you will need to find hosting and web design services
on your own.

[Do you offer payment plans?][28]

Yes we offer payment plans for up to 12 months. [See details][29].

[How do I keep my personal information private?][30]

If you wish the domain ownership information to be private, add WhoIs Privacy Protection to your
domain. This hides your personal information from the general public.

WhoIs Privacy Protection for free for the first year, and then for a small fee for subsequent years.

update, and different registrars are faster than others. Usually your Whois information will be
fully updated within two days.

# Air Ambulance, Worldwide

Air Ambulance America has been arranging medical transprtation since 1983. We are highly experienced
and professional. Our team of air ambulance transportation specialists arrange medical flights which
are staffed by flight nurses and paramedics. For your safety, all chartered aircrafts are operated
by FAA-licensed air carriers. The aircrafts are approved for medical flight operations, and include
state-of-the-art medical and Support Equipment onboard. Air Ambulance America gives the highest
level of attention and support to all patients, from Basic to Critical Care:

Including, but not limited to: Burn and wound patients, Traumatic brain injuries, Spinal cord
injuries, Stroke, Cancer, Hospice, Nursing Home, Fragile Patients, Heart and Transplant Patients,
Organ Transplants, among many others.

Medical Team Members are Trained in Flight Physiology. These include Registered Nurses- RN,
Respiratory Therapists (RT) and Registered Flight Paramedics on board. We can arrange to have a
Doctor on the flight upon request. Any need or request can be met by our expertly trained
individuals.

the most seamless and smoothest trip possible. Let one of our flight coordinator experts help you to
arrange a worry-free medical transport. Our staff has over 30 years of experience. We have gained
the trust of hospitals worldwide and our support is available 24 hours a day.
Call our call center 24/7/365!

[Equipped]

### Equipped

Rivaling patient care in some of the finest hospitals, AirMed air ambulances are equipped for
virtually every critical care scenario. And unlike others in the industry, we have our own fleet so
we can guarantee a quality medical flight and exceptional care across the board. All of AirMed's
flight crews are simulator trained annually, which exceeds industry standards, and all long-range
pilots hold ATP ratings.

[More Info][117]

[aircraft blueprint]

## The AirMed Air Ambulance Fleet

As an FAA-certified Air Carrier with worldwide operating authority, our air ambulance fleet consists
of Part 135 ATP Certified flight crew that are simulator trained annually and are type-specific
rated. Maintenance professionals are required to release long-range aircraft for each air ambulance
flight and accept the aircraft upon return.

### Experienced

The team at AirMed International has pioneered the air ambulance and air medical transport industry
for over three decades. The dedication and expertise of our team allow us to deliver a seamless
transport experience bedside-to-bedside from anywhere on the globe.

[Learn more][115]



[Trusted]

### Trusted

AirMed International is the leading air ambulance and medical transport company in the United
States, with 33,000 total missions and counting. AirMed offers unparalleled medical care and
bedside-to-bedside transportation on a worldwide basis and boasts the most experienced air medical
crews in the industry.

[Read more][116]
[Equipped]

### Equipped

Rivaling patient care in some of the finest hospitals, AirMed air ambulances are equipped for
virtually every critical care scenario. And unlike others in the industry, we have our own fleet so
we can guarantee a quality medical flight and exceptional care across the board. All of AirMed's
flight crews are simulator trained annually, which exceeds industry standards, and all long-range
pilots hold ATP ratings.

[More Info][117]

[aircraft blueprint]

## The AirMed Air Ambulance Fleet

As an FAA-certified Air Carrier with worldwide operating authority, our air ambulance fleet consists
of Part 135 ATP Certified flight crew that are simulator trained annually and are type-specific
rated. Maintenance professionals are required to release long-range aircraft for each air ambulance
flight and accept the aircraft upon return.

[Raytheon Hawker 800][118] [Beechjet 400][119] [Learjet 35A][120]

# Med-Trans Air Medical Transport

Med-Trans is focused on establishing customized air medical programs for health care systems and EMS
agencies across the United States. We offer a broad range of solutions, and along with our partners,
provide unmatched clinical care and service to our communities.

[Helicopter.png]

##### Why Med-Trans?
* Superior patient care, safety and world-class aviation operations
* Family-based culture that respects our heritage while constantly looking for ways to improve our
  processes
* Committed to our Partners – their challenges are our challenges, and we succeed together

[UT LIFESTAR Celebrates 40 Years of Serving East Tennessee]

##### UT LIFESTAR Celebrates 40 Years of Serving East Tennessee

The organization airlifted its first patient on October 1, 1984, and since then, it has transported
more than 50,000 patients.

[ Read more (opens in a new tab) ][24]

## Your Future in Air Ambulance Services

[EMT Female]Flight Paramedic
[Nurse Male]Flight Nurse
[Pilot]Pilot
[Worker]Aviation Maintenance Technician
[Telecom Female]Communication Specialist

Med-Trans offers customized air ambulance programs through alternative delivery/shared resource
models, community-based models and traditional hospital-based models. Working with our partners, our
team members understand that theirs is not just a job, but a way of life. At the end of the day,
they know they have made a difference in someone’s life and are part of something bigger than
themselves.

### Partners in Care

We make a difference in peoples’ lives and provide value to our partners. Join our family to make a
difference today!

[Apply Today][25]

Visit our Facebook page for company updates, employee photos & stories, job postings and more. [Read
More][26] [FBPostImage]

### Membership

**Enrolling or renewing your membership is fast and easy! Get started by clicking the button
below.**

[Learn More][27]
Extraordinary Stories.
Extraordinary People.
[[At a Moment's Notice]][28]
[[Med-Trans. A Global Medical Response Solution.]][29]

We improve the lives of those we serve while providing professional value to our partners. Med-Trans
is a part of the Global Medical Response family.

### Mission, Vision, & Values

Our mission is a simple one: One Team, delivering quality-driven, patient-centric, mobile integrated
healthcare.

Our vision is to lead mobile integrated healthcare through innovation, reliability, and
customer-focus.

Our values of Safety, Integrity, Excellence, Accountability and Compassion put patients first.

### Our People

Our nurse-paramedic teams work under protocols that have been developed by recognized leaders in
trauma, cardiovascular medicine and pediatrics which allow them to render the best medical care
possible. Additionally our Medical Control Physicians are available twenty-four hours a day when our
crews need an immediate consultation.

When life is on the line, it becomes all the more precious. Every day, emergency response and
medical workers battle conditions that may damage or destroy life.

#### What is it?
* Capture and send your GPS coordinates to MedFlight’s Communication Center with the Helo Alert
  function.
* Secure an encrypted SSL transmission.
* Send appropriate photos to MedFlight’s Communication Specialist.
* Receive immediate ETA and availability of MedFlight’s closest helicopter.
* Alert MedFlight for a possible activation of the critical care transport team and aircraft,
  reducing response time.
* Continue to communicate with MedFlight’s Communications Specialists.

#### How it Works:
* Download, register, get approved and begin using the app.
* Open app and press “helo.” The window will pre-populate with your location.
* Use SMS text; type patient weight and note if another service has been contacted for the
  transport.
* MedFlight’s Communications Center will response with availability and ETA.
* **PLEASE NOTE: Registration DOES NOT bypass your normal 911 protocols and will require your
  management approval. Your local 911 center will be contacted to confirm your location and that
  your scene is active.**
* **Your local 911 center will be contacted to confirm your location and that your scene is

#### Questions?

Do you still have a question about registration? How about a question regarding who should use
MetroAlert? We’re happen to answer these and any other questions you might have. You can reach us
using the form below, by emailing [MedFlightHeloAlert@medflight.com][85] or by calling [(614)

1.  How do I register to use the Metro Alert App for the first time?
    
    To get started, you first must download and install the App on your device; for iPhone download
    from the [Apple App Store][87] and for Android download from the [Google Play Store][88]. Once
    installed, open and start the Metro Alert application to begin the registration process using
    the navigation steps below:
    
    Please note: You must register and be “authorized” by your agency to use the app “MedFlight Helo
    Alert” request feature. If you do not need to use the “MedFlight Helo Alert”, you do not need to
    register. When registering, for both iPhone and Android versions, it is very important that all
    registration form information is accurate and complete. Please avoid using abbreviations or
    other shorthand to describe your dispatch center’s name, agency, or hospital.
    
    1. Please select “MedFlight of Ohio” Columbus OH from the program list.
    2. Agree to the terms and conditions to use the app.
    3. Agree to the acknowledgement of confidentiality of patient health information.
    
    As noted above, the additional steps are only required if you wish to use the “MedFlight Helo
    Alert” feature:
    
    1. On the “MedFlight Helo Alert” screen, press “Continue”. (Internet data services are required)
    2. Please complete the form by providing all required field information. Remember; please
    provide accurate and complete information. This information is needed to complete the
    registration approval process and to ensure that the correct local dispatch center is contacted
    for activation requests.
    3. User logon authentication is also required to use this feature. Your login user name will be
    the email address that you used to register with. Your password must be at least six characters
    and is case specific. Please make note of your password.
    
    Once you are approved for activation, you will be sent an email and also receive a push alert on
    your mobile device.
2.  What if I get a new phone or device? Do I need to do anything regarding the use of the
    MetroAlert App?
    
    Yes, it is the actual device that is registered, NOT the person who owns it. So if you get a new
    phone or device, you must download and re-register your new device.
3.  What if I forget my password or need to change it?
    
    To reset or change your password you must first remove the application from your device,
    download and re-install, and then re-register you and the device for MedFlight Helo activation.
4.  I work for multiple agencies. When I register to be able to use the app, which should I use?
    
    Please use your primary agency. The Metro Alert application can only be registered to one agency
    and local dispatch center per device. When the Metro Alert app is used to request the helicopter
    while working for a secondary agency, you can notify our Communications Center during the
    activation process.
5.  Will the MetroAlert App be used to bypass incident command or local 911 protocols?
    
    No, using the app’s MedFlight Helo Alert activation request feature does not bypass your normal
    911 dispatch protocols and is meant as an aid for early activation to request a medical
    helicopter. This is accomplished by capturing your GPS coordinates and request specifics to send
    to MedFlight’s Communications Center. Once received by our Communications Center, your request
    will be acknowledged back to you through the mobile app who will then immediately contact your
    registered dispatch center or hospital unit to confirm the request and obtain further
    information.
6.  Can the MetroAlert App be used to request the helicopter when en route to the scene vs. upon
    arrival?
    
    Yes! To save valuable minutes, as soon as you think you will need a helicopter! This process
    allows us to start the activation process much earlier and although the GPS coordinates will not
    be those of the actual scene, text can be added to the request to alert MedFlight’s
    Communication Center that you are en route and will update GPS coordinates once at scene.
7.  What if someone intentionally misuses the app to launch the helicopter?
    
    Mistakes will happen and MedFlight reviews all user registration requests and will only activate
    and grant access to the Helo Activation module once your respective agency has been contacted
    and you have been approved for Helo activation use by your supervisory personnel. If
    inappropriate utilization of this module occurs by an individual, access will be terminated
    immediately and your agency contacted.
8.  Can I request multiple helicopters using the app?
    
    Yes! By utilizing the secure text capabilities of the Helo Activation module, you can notify our
    Communications Center that multiple aircraft are needed. We’ll coordinate the resources you need
    – including utilizing other air medical programs to dispatch the most appropriate helicopter
    given GPS your location. We will also keep your dispatch center notified of all incoming
    aircraft.
9.  Will I receive updates or push notifications on the estimated time of arrival of the aircraft?
    (ETA)
    
    Yes! Utilizing the apps’s built-in ETA push notification feature, MedFlight’s Communications
    Center will keep you updated once the aircraft has lifted and is en route to your destination.
10. Can I use the app on an iPad or other tablet devices?
    
    The App will run on an iPad or Android tablet with reliable data and cellular service
    capabilities; however it was specifically designed to run on iPhone and Android mobile phones.
11. Do I need to enable “Location Services” on my mobile device for the Helo Request Module to work?
    
    Yes, for the MedFlight Helo Activation to work properly, Location Services must be enabled. It
    is not necessary for the other App modules.

### Initial contact & case evaluation

Medical history, condition assessment, transport feasibility check.

### Mission planning

Aircraft selection, medical crew assignment, equipment readiness.

### Ground transport to airport

Ambulance, stretcher, medical escort.

### Medical flight under care

Continuous monitoring, emergency readiness, comfort, oxygen / ventilation if needed.

### Ground transport to destination hospital

Stretcher transfer, hospital handover, medical documentation.

## EAA awarded Air Ambulance Company of the Year 2024

We are delighted and honoured to announce that EAA has been awarded ‘Air Ambulance Company of the
Year’ 2024 by the ITIJ: International Travel & Health Insurance Journal!

[Four men standing in front of a private jet, two holding an award plaque and a trophy, smiling at
the camera.]
Process

## How air ambulance works with us

### Initial contact & case evaluation

Medical history, condition assessment, transport feasibility check.

### Mission planning

Aircraft selection, medical crew assignment, equipment readiness.

### Ground transport to airport

Ambulance, stretcher, medical escort.

### Medical flight under care

Continuous monitoring, emergency readiness, comfort, oxygen / ventilation if needed.

### Ground transport to destination hospital

Stretcher transfer, hospital handover, medical documentation.

[Close-up of a red airplane tail fin with a white outline map of Europe showing country names
including Germany, Poland, and Italy, inside a hangar.]
expertise

## Saving Lives, Worldwide

**European Air Ambulance provides fast, reliable medical repatriation and specialised air‑medical
transport worldwide.** Our expert crews and advanced equipment ensure safe, high‑quality care for
every patient—wherever they are.

[Discover all services][14]

## Worldwide Medical Air Ambulance — Available 24/7

Medical emergencies strike without warning.

[Request medical assistance][15]
BENEFITS

## Why choose EAA ?

Medical staff

### Our medical team

EAA only recruits highly-qualified, experienced and clinically-active medical staff, who undergo
continuous training in critical care and emergency medicine.

[Discover Medical Staff][16]
[Smiling airport ground staff in a yellow safety vest standing beside medical equipment on a trolley
in front of an airplane.]
In-transit critical-care units

### Our fleet

Our fleet is composed of two Bombardier Challenger 605 for long range flights and three Bombardier
Learjet 45XR for shorter distances. All our jets are dedicated to medical flights.

[Discover our fleet][17]
[Tail section of a white and red ambulance airplane parked outside a hangar with a person giving a
thumbs-up from inside the hangar.]
Mission control center

### Our support team

EAA operations are co-ordinated by our 24/7/365 Mission Control Centre based on-site together at our
state-of-the-art headquarters.

[Discover Mission Control Center][18]
[Seven men in casual and business attire gathered around a white conference table with two large
monitors in a room with maps on the walls.]
Fleet

# Worldwide Medical Flights: Safe, Fast, Patient-Driven

For safe medical evacuations and repatriations across the globe, opt for our air ambulance,
commercial medical escort flights or long-distance ground ambulances. With ICU equipment onboard, we
provide unparalleled care for sick and injured patients abroad - from your doorstep and in the
skies.

Contact us for a free consultation session to create a solution tailored to your needs. We listen,
advise and organize EVERYTHING for you, for your peace of mind. Choose among our several patient
transport options.

# Your way home

Swift pickup wherever you are
A ground ambulance will pick you up from your home/from the hospital for a safe transfer to the
airport
Safe medical flight
Where our air ambulance will be waiting for you. You will be constantly taken care of by our expert
medical team, both on the ground and in the sky.
Ground transport at your destination
Upon landing, a ground ambulance will instantly take you to your destination, ensuring a swift and
safe transport.

## Medical Aviation: Our Range of Medical Planes

Our fleet of ambulance planes and helicopters allows us to customize your medical transport. We
cover both large international airports and smaller airfields for optimal efficiency and safety.

# Worldwide Medical Flights: Safe, Fast, Patient-Driven

For safe medical evacuations and repatriations across the globe, opt for our air ambulance,
commercial medical escort flights or long-distance ground ambulances. With ICU equipment onboard, we
provide unparalleled care for sick and injured patients abroad - from your doorstep and in the
skies.

Contact us for a free consultation session to create a solution tailored to your needs. We listen,
advise and organize EVERYTHING for you, for your peace of mind. Choose among our several patient
transport options.

airport

Upon landing, a ground ambulance will instantly take you to your destination, ensuring a swift and

Our fleet of ambulance planes and helicopters allows us to customize your medical transport. We

# Transport

## Là où l’excellence médicale rencontre un transport aérien sans égal

### Une entreprise d’ici qui va loin

continuité clinique rigoureuse et un standard d’excellence, partout au Canada comme à

de sécurité, de qualité clinique et de performance opérationnelle. Pour nos patients comme pour nos
partenaires, c’est l’assurance d’un transport médical aérien réalisé avec rigueur, expertise et
confiance, partout dans le monde.

[ DEMANDER UN TRANSPORT ][6]

### Partenaire de
### confiance

### Service
### Fiable

### Une attention
### dévouée

Depuis plus de 12 ans, Airmedic développe une expertise reconnue en transport médical aérien, au
Canada comme à l’international. Notre organisation est certifiée par [**Transports Canada**][7] et
fièrement accréditée [**EURAMI**][8], une distinction internationale qui confirme que nos opérations
respectent les plus hauts standards de sécurité, de qualité et d’excellence opérationnelle.

Cette double reconnaissance témoigne de la rigueur de nos processus, de la fiabilité de nos
opérations et de notre engagement constant envers la sécurité des patients et des équipes. Chaque
mission est réalisée selon des protocoles stricts et une approche centrée sur les meilleures
pratiques du transport médical aérien moderne.

Airmedic exploite une flotte d’ambulances aériennes spécialement configurées pour le transport
médical aérien au Canada et à l’international. Conçus pour prendre en charge des patients aux
conditions variées, nos aéronefs permettent d’effectuer des évacuations d’urgence, des rapatriements
médicaux et des transports de soins critiques avec un haut niveau de fiabilité opérationnelle.

Pensé comme de véritables environnements cliniques, chaque appareil intègre des équipements médicaux
avancés soutenant la prise en charge continue du patient pendant le vol. Nos équipes médicales
spécialisées travaillent en étroite coordination avec les opérations aériennes afin d’assurer des
interventions sécuritaires, efficaces et adaptées à la complexité de chaque mission.

La communication claire et constante est au cœur de notre service. Nous nous engageons à fournir des
solutions personnalisées, adaptées à chaque situation, tout en garantissant une transparence totale
à chaque étape du processus. Nos équipes médicales et opérationnelles travaillent en étroite
collaboration pour offrir un service fiable et sans compromis, jour et nuit. Avec un suivi en temps
réel et une coordination fluide, nous assurons que chaque transport se déroule en toute sécurité,
avec une priorité absolue sur le bien-être des patients et la tranquillité d’esprit des familles et
partenaires.

## America's Air Ambulance
## Leader

[Learn More][14] [Get a Quote][15]

## About Us

### American Air Ambulance and its emergency air care service is the trusted leader for medical air
### transportation internationally.
* Our service providers have safely flown over 72,000 patients worldwide since 1986.
* The experience of our staff and crews make it easy for you to arrange for the best flight, the
  best service and the best cost.
* Contact a flight consultant for free, no-obligation advice.

## Air Medical Care Services

Call us for immediate answers to air ambulance, medevac, emergency air lift transportation, medical
air transport, or patient escort questions. Your medical air transportation questions will be
answered by our team of courteous, professional personnel that can assist you in multiple languages
and ** there is never any obligation. **

#### [Medical Escort][16]

Our trained medical assistants on board the aircraft work hard to make our patients and customers
feel comfortable throughout the course of their flight.

#### [Amtrak Train Escort][17]

One of our most cost effective means of patient transport is Amtrak Medical Escort. Prices are well
below air and long distance ground transport.

#### [Air Ambulance][18]

American Air Ambulance provides unequaled value in executive service, aircraft quality, reliability
and dependability that you expect from a world-class air ambulance service.

#### [Long Distance Ground][19]

For inter-facility transports under two hundred miles, air transport is not cost effective. In
addition, some non-critical patients prefer the cost savings of longer distance ground transport.

## Accreditation

## Our Safety Record

American Air Ambulance is committed to the highest safety standards when referring and transporting
their customers and their loved ones with medevac stat air transportation.
* Our medical transportation safety record continues to be the highest in the international air
  ambulance industry.
* Our Air Ambulance Service providers are staffed with Certified Air Medical Transport Professionals
  who specialize in long distance air medical transportation via worldwide medical transportation
  charters and patient escort services.
* Our Air Medical Transport price guarantee assures that your family will receive air ambulance
  services at prices competitive with any medivac or emergency air lift flight choices worldwide.

## Testimonials

American Air Ambulance has received many letters from families expressing gratitude. Some of the
comments we have received are paraphrased below.

My husband and I wanted to thank you and your whole staff for the caring concern that you showed us.
The professional manner that you all had was coupled with a warm concern that we both felt.

### Dr. & Mrs. Duane Schultz

#### Francstown, NH

My wife and I were impressed with your efficiency in arranging the ground and air transportation,
and with your empathy and understanding of our concerns for my father's welfare.

### Polly S. Freeze

#### Clearwater, FL

I would highly recommend your company to anyone who needed your service. You have the most caring
crew I have ever met. They took great care of my grandfather and made my mother's flight back home
safe and comfortable.

### Maribel Lee

#### Scotch Plains, NJ

Agradezco enormemente todo lo que hiciste por mi hermana. La atencion que le dieron fue excelente,
sinceramente losfelicito por su servicio, y a ti te admiro por ese sentido humanitario quemostraste
en todo momento

### Juan Giovannetti M.

#### Bogota, Columbia

Just wanted to say thank you for making a very difficult time for Alta Rufton and her brother,
Robert Hinkle as easy as possible. You helped us fulfill Alta's last wish of returning to her true
home. Thanks again for your kindness.

### John Janneillo

#### Rochester, NY

We are available 24 hours a day, year round. American Air Ambulance is at your disposal for

# Critical Care Air Transport

Organized and efficient, Blue Sky Aero Medical will take care of you or your loved ones’ needs.

[REQUEST A QUOTE ONLINE][20]

###### Case Managers

Blue Sky Aero Medical, is a critical care air ambulance providing air ambulance transportation
anywhere in the World including the United States, Canada, The Caribbean, and Mexico.

[Read More][21]

###### Critical Care

###### Air Ambulance

Worldwide service for Critical Care patients in need of an urgent evacuation for a higher level of
care. Our critical care air ambulance team has specialized flight-training experience, expertise,
and equipment to handle everything from basic to critical care support.

[Read More][22]

###### Medical Escort /
###### Travel Companion

Domestic or international medical repatriations. Senior caregivers and companionship during travels.
Our companions assist seniors throughout the entire trip.

[Read More][23]

###### Commercial Airline Stretcher

A great alternative to air ambulance to fly a patient. Available worldwide, we provide medical crew
and equipment.

[Read More][24]

###### Medical Travel Costs
###### Contigency/Containment

Consultancy services for planning and containing international medical health care costs. Our
feasibility analysis overviews potential costs.

[Read More][25]

When traveling the world, it’s important to feel like you are only one flight away from everything
you need, especially when you find yourself in emergency medical situations. With our Blue Sky
Aeromedical transport team, we provide exactly that—24-7 critical care air transport for our valued
clients!   

## Blue Sky Air Critical Care Air Medical Transport 
## Excellence in Service!

As a medically focused organization, we acknowledge the need for immediate and flexible care. That’s
why we stand by our “excellence in service” motto. We provide international critical care air
medical transport and work to maximize patient comfort as you travel to your next destination. But
you don’t have to worry about being in the hands of those without the proper expertise. Our
professional staff boasts proven experience with critical care medicine and the aeromedical
transport of patients. From our critical care air ambulance to travel companions, our team is
dedicated to fulfilling all your healthcare needs when you’re away from home. This assistance allows
you to feel more relaxed as you make your journey and focus on the healing process!

 

Please don’t hesitate to contact us at Blue Sky Aeromedical to learn more about our critical care
air transport services; we’ll gladly answer any remaining questions or concerns. Let us help you
take the next steps in receiving the proper medical care.

[Lizbeth Castrejon][26]

> "These guys are amazing. They made it possible to transport my sister from Mexico City to Atlanta
> bed to bed and took care of everything for us, including insurance. David Smith has helped us
> through everything and followed up with us even after we landed back in the US. If ever in need, I
> would recommend anyone to these guys. Could not be more thankful for them. 10/10"

[REQUEST A QUOTE ONLINE][27]

## PROVEN IN THE FIELD: REAL STORIES OF STRENGTH AND RELIABILITY

“We talked with some of the largest departments in the country and they all had exceptional reviews
about working with Braun Industries. In the end, Braun was able to deliver on all of our requests -
when no other manufacturer could. They went above and beyond in proving to us they were in it for
the long haul.”
Chief Carl FloresNew Orleans EMS
[Chief Carl Flores]
“The quality of the Braun product is very evident, they put the other ambulances in our fleet to
shame. Before you commit to buying any new ambulance, or when you pick one up, be sure to take them
up on the offer of a factory tour. I have never seen a manufacturing facility that is so organized
and clean."
Chief Douglas LaFondAllen Park Fire Department
[Chief Douglas LaFond]
“When choosing Braun, it essentially came down to the fact that there was no design challenge that
we threw at them that they were not able to facilitate for us. The quality and craftsmanship of
Braun was unparalleled to other units we looked at and also weighed heavily on our decision.”
Ryan Ferris, Transport EMT, EVOFletcher Allen Health Care
[Ryan Ferris, Transport EMT, EVO]
“The Braun ambulance speaks for itself. There’s no other vehicle out there built as well…and they
would, of course, be more than welcome to look at ours. Out of all the many ambulances I’ve worked
in during my nearly 30 years in the business, the Braun always comes out on top as the best for many
proven reasons."
John Marko, Executive Director & ParamedicNorthern Onondaga Volunteer Ambulance, Inc.
[John Marko, Executive Director & Paramedic]
“The police department’s ambulance fleet consists of approximately 40 Braun Chief XL ambulances. Our
ambulance fleet provides a critical service to our residents. Our buses provide around the clock
assistance in often times harsh driving conditions. My automotive supervisors who prepare the
specifications for our buses and those who oversee the maintenance of these vital pieces of
equipment can attest to their superior quality, roadworthiness and workmanship."
Donald F. Halbohn, Police InspectorNassau County Police Department
[Donald F. Halbohn, Police Inspector]
“Whether you buy one ambulance a year, or one every 10 years, the staff at Braun Ambulances are
committed to building quality ambulances and forging lifelong relationships. From my very first tour
of their plant in Van Wert, OH and each one in between, it’s easy to see the men and women at Braun
Ambulances are dedicated to building the safest and most durable ambulances in the industry. Braun’s
commitment to their customers doesn’t end when you drive away, in fact, it’s just beginning."
Peter O’Leary, Fire ChiefFond du Lac Fire Rescue
[Peter O’Leary, Fire Chief]
"I trust Braun Ambulances. They’re built tough, built safe, and built for life. Braun took the time
to listen, understand our needs, and deliver a custom ambulance that is built to last. With Braun, I
know we're providing our community with the very best, and that means we can focus on what matters
most—saving lives."
Chief John Jones,Van Wert Fire Department
[ Chief John Jones,]

Our five innovative models are the foundation for limitless customization, ensuring your vehicle is

to detail, every module is purpose-built to deliver a tailored fit and finish—a premium custom
ambulance designed not just for today, but for a lifetime of dependable performance. Built with
superior materials and time-tested engineering, Braun ambulances embody the quality and trust you

## PROVEN IN THE FIELD: REAL STORIES OF STRENGTH AND RELIABILITY

“We talked with some of the largest departments in the country and they all had exceptional reviews
about working with Braun Industries. In the end, Braun was able to deliver on all of our requests -
when no other manufacturer could. They went above and beyond in proving to us they were in it for
the long haul.”
Chief Carl FloresNew Orleans EMS
[Chief Carl Flores]
“The quality of the Braun product is very evident, they put the other ambulances in our fleet to
shame. Before you commit to buying any new ambulance, or when you pick one up, be sure to take them
up on the offer of a factory tour. I have never seen a manufacturing facility that is so organized
and clean."
Chief Douglas LaFondAllen Park Fire Department
[Chief Douglas LaFond]
“When choosing Braun, it essentially came down to the fact that there was no design challenge that
we threw at them that they were not able to facilitate for us. The quality and craftsmanship of
Braun was unparalleled to other units we looked at and also weighed heavily on our decision.”
Ryan Ferris, Transport EMT, EVOFletcher Allen Health Care
[Ryan Ferris, Transport EMT, EVO]
“The Braun ambulance speaks for itself. There’s no other vehicle out there built as well…and they
would, of course, be more than welcome to look at ours. Out of all the many ambulances I’ve worked
in during my nearly 30 years in the business, the Braun always comes out on top as the best for many
proven reasons."
John Marko, Executive Director & ParamedicNorthern Onondaga Volunteer Ambulance, Inc.
[John Marko, Executive Director & Paramedic]
“The police department’s ambulance fleet consists of approximately 40 Braun Chief XL ambulances. Our
ambulance fleet provides a critical service to our residents. Our buses provide around the clock
assistance in often times harsh driving conditions. My automotive supervisors who prepare the
specifications for our buses and those who oversee the maintenance of these vital pieces of
equipment can attest to their superior quality, roadworthiness and workmanship."
Donald F. Halbohn, Police InspectorNassau County Police Department
[Donald F. Halbohn, Police Inspector]
“Whether you buy one ambulance a year, or one every 10 years, the staff at Braun Ambulances are
committed to building quality ambulances and forging lifelong relationships. From my very first tour
of their plant in Van Wert, OH and each one in between, it’s easy to see the men and women at Braun
Ambulances are dedicated to building the safest and most durable ambulances in the industry. Braun’s
commitment to their customers doesn’t end when you drive away, in fact, it’s just beginning."
Peter O’Leary, Fire ChiefFond du Lac Fire Rescue
[Peter O’Leary, Fire Chief]
"I trust Braun Ambulances. They’re built tough, built safe, and built for life. Braun took the time
to listen, understand our needs, and deliver a custom ambulance that is built to last. With Braun, I
know we're providing our community with the very best, and that means we can focus on what matters
most—saving lives."
Chief John Jones,Van Wert Fire Department

# Experience. Service. Professionalism. Excellence.

 

 

## Excellence in Air Ambulance, Cargo, Flight Training, Aircraft Maintenance, Performance, and
## Safety.

#### Carson Air Ltd. provides fixed wing medevac services for the Province of British Columbia and
#### cargo services across Alberta and BC.

[Our Services][26]

# Air Ambulance

Carson Air takes pride in serving communities of British Columbia through daily contracted medevac
services for the province and chartered medevac across North America. Our highly-qualified,
experienced and dedicated medevac pilots fly technologically advanced aircraft to provide the best
level of medevac service in a safe and timely manner.

 

 

 

[Learn More][27]
[Aircraft Walkthrough][28]

## Cargo Services

We partner with FedEx to fly air cargo to key cities throughout the province of British Columbia
with our cargo operations base located in Calgary, Alberta at the Calgary International Airport.

[Learn More][29]

# Flight Training

Want to learn to fly with the pros? Through a partnership with Okanagan College, we offer full time
college business diploma program or self-paced flight training programs that will get you flying!
From private to commercial, multi-engine, instrument rating and instructor ratings, we cover it all.

[Learn More][30]

monitoring system that fits securely into your hospital’s network to give you all-time data access

[Learn more][88]

#### Continually evolving care for newborns

As Your Specialist in Acute Care, we continue developing outstanding technology and delivering
innovative design that is focused on your newborns.

[Learn more][89]
[xnode]

#### Dräger X-node

Dräger X-node is a wireless IoT solution for process monitoring and analysis. The system solution
converts reliable measurement data - gas concentration, temperature, humidity and pressure - from
the X-node device into valuable information that you can access, analyse, visualise, monitor and
store online via the X-node Hub.

[Learn more][90]
[X-plore-8300-carpentry-3-2]

Reliable respiratory protection against harmful particles with no noticeable breathing resistance or
restriction to movement: The Dräger X-plore 8300 is the smallest and lightest PAPR device in its
class, offering maximum protection and comfort.

[Learn more][91]
[Main-Suraksha-Parmo-Dharma-v2-3-2]

As trusted partners, we are dedicated to ensuring that no matter the complexity of the task, you
have Dräger's unwavering support. 

Suraksha Parmo Dharma, a Sanskrit maxim, it means safety is the highest duty. In an era where
workplace hazards, industrial accidents and emergency response risks persist.

[Learn more][92]

## **Not sure who to support? [Get in touch][26] so we can help.**
## 
## **Your Local Air Ambulance** is our regional emergency service, delivering rapid, advanced
## critical care across five counties (Warwickshire & Northamptonshire and Derbyshire,
## Leicestershire & Rutland). Deeply rooted in the communities it serves, YLAA relies on local
## support and pride. It’s often first on the scene, bringing clinical excellence and compassion
## when seconds matter most.
## 
## **The National Children’s Air Ambulance** is a national service dedicated to transferring
## critically ill babies and children between hospitals. Working closely with NHS partners, it
## ensures specialist care is accessible wherever it’s needed. NCAA is defined by its safety,
## expertise, and the hope it brings to families during their most critical moments.

###### Medway Air Ambulance

# Trusted Global Medical Flight Services Since 2000

Medway Air Ambulance is a leading provider of medical flight services in North America, with over
two decades of experience transporting critically ill patients to specialized facilities worldwide.
Our expanding fleet and unblemished safety record ensure rapid, reliable, and compassionate
care—wherever it’s needed.

[Call US: (800)233-0655][28]

#### Our **Certifications**

## **14,000**+ Medical Flights

### **Safety & Reliability**

Our No. 1 goal is ensuring our patients arrive at their destination safely and feel as comfortable
as possible along the way. This is why we employ a full-time staff of doctors, nurses, mechanics,
pilots, and flight coordinators to guarantee that every aspect of our service is truly of the
highest caliber. Plus, we own and operate our fleet, which gives us full control over flight
scheduling.

### **History & Experience**

Medway was established in 2000, and over the years, we have faithfully served our patients with the
utmost dedication and integrity. Our pilots have decades of experience, and our highly educated
medical staff is fully equipped to provide top-tier care for the most critically ill patients.
That’s why families throughout the world trust us to get them wherever they need to go.

### **Promise To Patients**

We are fully dedicated to ensuring the safety and comfort of all our patients. If you need a flight
to a nearby city to receive specialized medical care or you were injured while traveling abroad and
need to get to a hospital close to home, we will be there for you every step of the way. We take
pride in our work and it shows through our unwavering commitment to our patients.

## **22,000**+ Medical Flights Completed

Unlike many other air ambulance companies, we don’t rely on brokers for our aircraft. Instead, we

for serving patients throughout the US, North America, and the world.

Our jets are equipped to function at up to ICU levels of care, ensuring we can provide care for
patients experiencing any medical condition. They have defibrillators, ventilators, oxygen supplies,
pulse oximeters, intubation equipment, and much more. Our dedicated Neonatal Pediatric Team flies

and newborns to specialized medical facilities. You can count on us for reliable medical care.

## Built on standards, not promises.

A vehicle only makes it onto our site after clearing a strict bar first — not by showing up and
hoping. Here's what that means for you.

### Every vehicle is licensed, insured & inspected

Valid BC commercial transportation licensing, solid liability coverage, and a safety checklist that
has to be passed — not just claimed. Before you ever step in, that groundwork is already done.

### Punctuality Guarantee

We keep tabs on your trip from the moment it's confirmed. Running late gets flagged to you
proactively — you're never just left guessing at the curb.

### Professional, Uniformed Chauffeurs

Background checks and professional training are the baseline, not the exception. You'll always be
greeted by a uniformed, courteous chauffeur.

### Transparent, All-In Pricing

No hidden fees, no surge surprises. Every quote shows the total cost upfront — gratuity, tolls, and
all. What you see is what you pay.

### 24/7 Human Support

Real people — not bots. Reach us any hour for changes, emergencies, or questions before, during, or
after your trip.

### Satisfaction Guarantee

If a ride falls short of what was promised, we make it right — full stop. Getting your experience
there is on us, start to finish.

proactively — you're never just left guessing at the curb.

### Professional, Uniformed Chauffeurs

Background checks and professional training are the baseline, not the exception. You'll always be
greeted by a uniformed, courteous chauffeur.

### Transparent, All-In Pricing

No hidden fees, no surge surprises. Every quote shows the total cost upfront — gratuity, tolls, and
all. What you see is what you pay.

after your trip.

there is on us, start to finish.

## О нас

За 16 лет работы «Авиакомпания «Северо-Запад» накопила солидный опыт в организации
VIP-авиаперевозок, заявила о себе, как о серьёзном участнике рынка. Приоритеты компании:
конфиденциальность, безопасность, комфорт.

Под управлением компании находятся воздушные суда самых известных мировых авиапроизводителей:
Gulfstream Aerospace, Bombardier Aerospace, Dassault Aviation, Leonardo Helicopters, Airbus. Базовые
аэропорты находятся в Москве и Санкт-Петербурге.

Преимуществом компании является наличие собственной диспетчерской службы 24/7 и собственных
представителей в региональных аэропортах.

## Airbus A321neo

Первый коммерческий рейс Airbus A321NEO
авиакомпании «Северо-Запад»

[Первый полёт Airbus A321neo авиакомпании Северо-запад]

В парк Авиакомпании «Северо-Запад» поступили два воздушных судна нового поколения A321 NEO в
моноклассе. Оба воздушных судна оборудованы салонами экономического класса, рассчитаны на перевозку
**236 пассажиров**, оснащены высокоэкономичными двигателями CFM LEAP-1A и признаны одними из
наиболее экологичных и тихих в своем классе.

Лайнеры с бортовыми номерами **RA-73027** и **RA-73028**, в указанной конфигурации, стали первыми
воздушными судами, внесенными в Государственный реестр гражданских воздушных судов Российской
Федерации.

Первый рейс RA-73027, состоявшийся **24 сентября 2021 года** был символично приурочен к открытию
аэропорта Тобольск, что стало очевидным свидетельством развития авиаотрасли Российской Федерации как
в части расширения количественного состава парков авиакомпаний, так и в части развития аэропортовой
инфраструктуры страны.

В настоящий момент флот Авиакомпании «Северо-Запад» насчитывает **23 воздушных судна**. Все они
ввезены в Российскую Федерацию и зарегистрированы в Государственном реестре гражданских воздушных
судов Российской Федерации. При этом, эксплуатация двух A321 NEO, новое направление деятельности
Авиакомпании, основным профилем которой, до этого момента, была сфера бизнес-авиации и, эксплуатация
таких типов воздушных судов как Gulfstream GVI, Gulfstream GV-SP, Falcon 7X, Falcon 900, Challenger
650, AW-139.

[Первый полёт Airbus A321neo авиакомпании Северо-запад]

В парк Авиакомпании «Северо-Запад» поступили два воздушных судна нового поколения A321 NEO в
моноклассе. Оба воздушных судна оборудованы салонами экономического класса, рассчитаны на перевозку
**236 пассажиров**, оснащены высокоэкономичными двигателями CFM LEAP-1A и признаны одними из
наиболее экологичных и тихих в своем классе.

Лайнеры с бортовыми номерами **RA-73027** и **RA-73028**, в указанной конфигурации, стали первыми
воздушными судами, внесенными в Государственный реестр гражданских воздушных судов Российской
Федерации.

Первый рейс RA-73027, состоявшийся **24 сентября 2021 года** был символично приурочен к открытию
аэропорта Тобольск, что стало очевидным свидетельством развития авиаотрасли Российской Федерации как
в части расширения количественного состава парков авиакомпаний, так и в части развития аэропортовой
инфраструктуры страны.

В настоящий момент флот Авиакомпании «Северо-Запад» насчитывает **23 воздушных судна**. Все они
ввезены в Российскую Федерацию и зарегистрированы в Государственном реестре гражданских воздушных
судов Российской Федерации. При этом, эксплуатация двух A321 NEO, новое направление деятельности
Авиакомпании, основным профилем которой, до этого момента, была сфера бизнес-авиации и, эксплуатация
таких типов воздушных судов как Gulfstream GVI, Gulfstream GV-SP, Falcon 7X, Falcon 900, Challenger
650, AW-139.

## Lift off Lotto

This year we’re celebrating 20 years of our Lift off Lotto, an incredible milestone! It’s raised
millions of pounds and there have been thousands of winners over the years.

As part of our celebration, we’re giving you even more chances to win, increasing the prizes from
six to 66.

[T&Cs apply][62]. Players must be 18 or over. Please gamble responsibly.

[Play today ][63]

## On Board With Us

Thank you to everyone who donated to add your name, or the name of someone special, to one of our
helicopters or critical care cars. They are now proudly displayed and with us on every mission.

On Board With Us will be back later this year. To be the first to hear about it, register your
interest today!

 

[Register your interest ][64]

## Join Team NWAA

Take on a challenge while supporting our lifesaving service. There’s plenty of events to choose
from. You could take on a run or skydive, a tough mudder or wing walk, there’s something to suit
everyone!

[Find out more][65]

## We rely entirely on your generosity

 

We’re funded not by the government or the NHS, but by you.

By donating, fundraising, shopping and supporting we can be there when people need us most.

Donate today and help us provide life-changing and lifesaving care, across the North West.

 

[Donate today][66]

### Take on a challenge

From sponsored runs and cycles to abseils and skydives, there's an event for everyone!
[Join Team NWAA][67]

### Meet our crew

Our specialist team works tirelessly 365 days of the year to provide urgent, pre-hospital care.
[Learn more][68]

### Volunteer with us

Together we can make a difference.
[Explore opportunities][69]

### Flying to save lives

Our patients are at the heart of everything we do.
[Read their stories][70]

### Brew for the Crew

Have a brew with your crew and raise vital funds for our lifesaving charity.
[Get involved][71]

### Join our crew

Do you want a rewarding career that enables you to make a lifesaving difference? Take a look at our
latest opportunities and see if there's a role for you.
[Latest opportunities][72]

## Lift off Lotto

This year we’re celebrating 20 years of our Lift off Lotto, an incredible milestone! It’s raised
millions of pounds and there have been thousands of winners over the years.

As part of our celebration, we’re giving you even more chances to win, increasing the prizes from
six to 66.

[T&Cs apply][62]. Players must be 18 or over. Please gamble responsibly.

[Play today ][63]

## On Board With Us

Thank you to everyone who donated to add your name, or the name of someone special, to one of our
helicopters or critical care cars. They are now proudly displayed and with us on every mission.

On Board With Us will be back later this year. To be the first to hear about it, register your
interest today!

 

[Register your interest ][64]

## Join Team NWAA

Take on a challenge while supporting our lifesaving service. There’s plenty of events to choose
from. You could take on a run or skydive, a tough mudder or wing walk, there’s something to suit
everyone!

[Find out more][65]

## We rely entirely on your generosity

 

We’re funded not by the government or the NHS, but by you.

By donating, fundraising, shopping and supporting we can be there when people need us most.

Donate today and help us provide life-changing and lifesaving care, across the North West.

 

[Donate today][66]

### Take on a challenge

From sponsored runs and cycles to abseils and skydives, there's an event for everyone!
[Join Team NWAA][67]

### Meet our crew

Our specialist team works tirelessly 365 days of the year to provide urgent, pre-hospital care.
[Learn more][68]

### Volunteer with us

Together we can make a difference.
[Explore opportunities][69]

### Flying to save lives

Our patients are at the heart of everything we do.
[Read their stories][70]

### Brew for the Crew

Have a brew with your crew and raise vital funds for our lifesaving charity.
[Get involved][71]

### Join our crew

Do you want a rewarding career that enables you to make a lifesaving difference? Take a look at our
latest opportunities and see if there's a role for you.
[Latest opportunities][72]
Previous Next

£18 million

**Most visited hospital**

Salford Royal

**Busiest day **

Sunday

**Critical care car missions in 2025**

1,524

## Events near you

Get stuck in and take on a challenge – we’ve got lots going on across the country.

It’s all thanks to your incredible support that we’re able to continue flying to save lives and make
a difference to those in emergency situations across the North West.

So whether you’re an adrenaline-junkie and you want to take to the skies, or you’re dreaming of
completing a bucket list challenge, we’ve got something for you.

[Get inspired][74]

Owler's exclusive company and industry insights make it easy to find competitors, leads, and
up-to-date news – so you can optimize your prospecting and sales results.

## For business professionals who want a serious competitive advantage

Owler Pro gives you access to premium features that keep your business in the loop about relevant
company, competitor, and industry news – so you can find qualified leads, improve your outreach, and
build better relationships with your customers.

**Follow an unlimited amount of companies relevant to your business needs**

**Discover new accounts, industry trends, and more**

**Get the latest news updates to stay ahead**

## For people who want an easier way to follow up to 5 companies that matter to them

Join Owler’s active community of 5 million+ business professionals and get exclusive insights about
competitors, prospects, and market updates that are only available to Owler users – so you can
ensure you stay ahead of the competition.

**Find detailed company information**

**Discover your closest competitors**

**Get real-time alerts and daily emails about relevant company and market news**

[ Learn about Owler Community ][64]

## What makes Owler different?

Discover your direct and indirect competitors with Owler's exclusive competitor graph.

Search accurate private and public company data for over 20 million companies.

Create targeted lists to get daily, personalized emails and alerts about news and companies that
matter to you.

Access detailed company data, including revenue, employee count, funding history, acquisitions,
news, and more.

Filter Owler’s entire database by revenue, sector, location, employee count, and public/private
company status.

## Trusted infrastructure for industry leading enterprises

For Enterprise IT

## Govern Kubernetes Without the Specialist Tax

Many organizations struggle to operate Kubernetes sustainably. Scarce specialists, massive tooling
ecosystems, and cluster environments sprawling across the enterprise make it difficult to maintain
control over container adoption: placing increasing pressure on governance, security, compliance,
and operational consistency.

This is the enterprise container management problem.

Portainer is the operational control plane that lets enterprise IT teams run Kubernetes and Docker
environments consistently, safely, predictably, and at scale: without depending on Kubernetes
specialists or platform engineering teams.

### Multi-Cluster Fleet Management

Centralized governance across Kubernetes clusters, and Docker hosts. Works with any Kubernetes
distribution: EKS, AKS, GKE, bare metal, or on-premises.

### GitOps Deployment Workflows

Centralized GitOps engine on the Portainer Server: not a controller running inside every cluster.
Promotion workflows from dev to staging to production with rollback, without the overhead of
distributed Argo or Flux installations.

### Self-Service with Guardrails

Enable developers to deploy safely without bottlenecks. Pre-defined templates, resource quotas, and
RBAC enforcement maintain control.

### Enterprise-Grade Identity & Access

Centralized SSO, LDAP, and OIDC integration. Role-based access control designed for real operational
teams with full audit logging.

## Trusted infrastructure for industry leading enterprises

## Govern Kubernetes Without the Specialist Tax

Many organizations struggle to operate Kubernetes sustainably. Scarce specialists, massive tooling
ecosystems, and cluster environments sprawling across the enterprise make it difficult to maintain
control over container adoption: placing increasing pressure on governance, security, compliance,
and operational consistency.

This is the enterprise container management problem.

Portainer is the operational control plane that lets enterprise IT teams run Kubernetes and Docker
environments consistently, safely, predictably, and at scale: without depending on Kubernetes
specialists or platform engineering teams.

### Multi-Cluster Fleet Management

Centralized governance across Kubernetes clusters, and Docker hosts. Works with any Kubernetes
distribution: EKS, AKS, GKE, bare metal, or on-premises.

### GitOps Deployment Workflows

Centralized GitOps engine on the Portainer Server: not a controller running inside every cluster.
Promotion workflows from dev to staging to production with rollback, without the overhead of
distributed Argo or Flux installations.

### Self-Service with Guardrails

Enable developers to deploy safely without bottlenecks. Pre-defined templates, resource quotas, and
RBAC enforcement maintain control.

# Discover. Connect. Act.

## Enterprise OSINT software platform

that transforms public data into actionable intelligence.
[ Discover Horizon® ][53]

### Speed

#### Investigations in seconds, not weeks.

Automate OSINT data collection and analysis across billions of public sources to dramatically reduce
investigation time. Horizon® OSINT software accelerates workflows so analysts can move from
discovery to action faster.

### Accuracy

#### Reduce false positives and improve case solve rates.

Advanced correlation, enrichment, and link analysis to help investigators surface relevant OSINT
signals and eliminate noise. Make confident decisions with cleaner, more reliable intelligence.

### Flexibility

#### Built to support investigators at every stage.

From initial OSINT inquiries to large-scale, multi-case investigations, Horizon® is designed to
align with established investigative methodologies, enabling efficient collection, analysis,
collaboration, and decision-making through intuitive tools, automation, and advanced controls.

### Ethical OSINT intelligence, by design.

Ethical OSINT data collection is foundational to ShadowDragon. Our OSINT software platform is
purpose built to support lawful, responsible investigations without compromising privacy or trust.
[ Trust Center ][54]

#### Real-time OSINT data

Continuously monitor publicly available OSINT data to identify emerging threats, risks, and
connections as they happen, not retrospectively.

#### No mass scraping or hacking

OSINT data is accessed responsibly without invasive scraping, credential misuse, or exploitation,
ensuring investigations remain ethical and defensible.

#### Unattributed searches

Conduct OSINT investigations without exposing analyst identities or investigative intent, protecting
operational security throughout the process.

#### Compliant to regulations

Built to support compliant OSINT investigations, Horizon® OSINT software aligns with data protection
and investigative standards across jurisdictions and regulated environments.

#### SOC 2 Type II Certified

Our enterprise OSINT software meets rigorous security requirements, with independently audited
controls designed for government and enterprise investigations.

#### Integrate OSINT, seamlessly.

# Discover. Connect. Act.

## Enterprise OSINT software platform

that transforms public data into actionable intelligence.
[ Discover Horizon® ][53]

### Speed

#### Investigations in seconds, not weeks.

Automate OSINT data collection and analysis across billions of public sources to dramatically reduce
investigation time. Horizon® OSINT software accelerates workflows so analysts can move from
discovery to action faster.

### Accuracy

#### Reduce false positives and improve case solve rates.

Advanced correlation, enrichment, and link analysis to help investigators surface relevant OSINT
signals and eliminate noise. Make confident decisions with cleaner, more reliable intelligence.

### Flexibility

#### Built to support investigators at every stage.

From initial OSINT inquiries to large-scale, multi-case investigations, Horizon® is designed to
align with established investigative methodologies, enabling efficient collection, analysis,
collaboration, and decision-making through intuitive tools, automation, and advanced controls.

### Ethical OSINT intelligence, by design.

Ethical OSINT data collection is foundational to ShadowDragon. Our OSINT software platform is
purpose built to support lawful, responsible investigations without compromising privacy or trust.
[ Trust Center ][54]

#### Real-time OSINT data

Continuously monitor publicly available OSINT data to identify emerging threats, risks, and
connections as they happen, not retrospectively.

#### No mass scraping or hacking

OSINT data is accessed responsibly without invasive scraping, credential misuse, or exploitation,
ensuring investigations remain ethical and defensible.

#### Unattributed searches

Conduct OSINT investigations without exposing analyst identities or investigative intent, protecting
operational security throughout the process.

#### Compliant to regulations

Built to support compliant OSINT investigations, Horizon® OSINT software aligns with data protection
and investigative standards across jurisdictions and regulated environments.

#### SOC 2 Type II Certified

Our enterprise OSINT software meets rigorous security requirements, with independently audited
controls designed for government and enterprise investigations.

One platform to integrate AI, data, apps, and services.

### Unify, simplify, amplify

Bring AI, applications and data integration together in a composable, unified, low-code platform
that accelerates automation and AI-led innovation.

### Innovators everywhere

Empower everyone across the enterprise to become an innovator, building and safely deploying
intelligent agents, apps or workflows with AI co-pilot, no-code builders and thousands of
connectors.

### AI with trust and control

Lead your organization into the AI-driven future with an easy-to-use, flexible, secure platform that
unlocks new opportunities at every turn. SnapLogic weaves governance, security, and transparency
into every workflow.

## One agentic integration platform. Four technologies.

agentic enterprise.

Break down silos and move data across any system, cloud, or on-premises. With SnapLogic pipelines,
you can integrate, transform, and deliver trusted data at scale. Power your analytics and operations
with data you can rely on.

## Meet the agentic integration company

One platform to integrate AI, data, apps, and services.

### Unify, simplify, amplify

Bring AI, applications and data integration together in a composable, unified, low-code platform
that accelerates automation and AI-led innovation.

### Innovators everywhere

Empower everyone across the enterprise to become an innovator, building and safely deploying
intelligent agents, apps or workflows with AI co-pilot, no-code builders and thousands of
connectors.

### AI with trust and control

Lead your organization into the AI-driven future with an easy-to-use, flexible, secure platform that
unlocks new opportunities at every turn. SnapLogic weaves governance, security, and transparency
into every workflow.

## One agentic integration platform. Four technologies.

One platform, one runtime, one upgrade path. Everything you need to connect, scale, and power your
agentic enterprise.

### Data Integration

#### Seamlessly connect data, everywhere

Break down silos and move data across any system, cloud, or on-premises. With SnapLogic pipelines,
you can integrate, transform, and deliver trusted data at scale. Power your analytics and operations
with data you can rely on.

## BECAUSE EVERY SECOND MATTERS

When the unthinkable happens, families need more than hope,they need immediate, specialist care.
That’s why The Air Ambulance Service exists: to bring lifesaving expertise to the most vulnerable
people, wherever they are, whenever they need it.

Through the [**National Children’s Air Ambulance**][49], we work alongside NHS clinical teams to
transfer critically ill babies and children to the specialist care that can save their lives.

Through [**Your Local Air Ambulance**][50], we deliver rapid emergency care to communities across
Warwickshire, Northamptonshire, Derbyshire, Leicestershire and Rutland — 24 hours a day, every day
of the year.

Because when time matters most, being there matters even more.
